title: Amazon Ads
cdp_relevance: campaign performance metrics + offline conversion upload (largely untapped: AMC, CAPI, audiences)
summary: Amazon's umbrella ad API (Sponsored Ads, DSP, Attribution/CAPI, AMC) that DAS uses via Media Logix for Sponsored Products campaign config and performance pull only.

title: Google Ads
cdp_relevance: campaign performance + gclid-matched offline conversion upload from DMS deals
summary: Google Ads API driving DAS's Media Logix Performance Max automation (account creation, campaigns, gclid offline conversions, reporting into AdCenter).

title: Meta / Facebook Marketing
cdp_relevance: campaign metrics, lead/review webhooks, vehicle catalog, hashed-PII conversions
summary: Meta's Marketing API spanning five DAS surfaces (Media Logix, DAS API, Social Logix/Radar, LotVantage, ETS) as both data source (metrics, reviews, leads) and destination (catalog, conversions).

title: Microsoft / Bing Ads
cdp_relevance: campaign metrics + MSCLKID offline conversion upload (planned, not yet live)
summary: Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) API that DAS uses via Media Logix for Search campaign management and reporting, with offline conversions flagged as a future phase.

title: Reddit Ads
cdp_relevance: campaign metrics from automotive-subreddit targeting (Conversions/Audiences untapped)
summary: Reddit Ads API v3 that Media Logix is integrating (in progress, no prod code confirmed) for automotive community/interest targeting with outbound campaign config and inbound reporting.

title: TikTok Ads
cdp_relevance: video campaign performance metrics (Events API, AIA, audiences untapped)
summary: TikTok Marketing API that DAS uses via Media Logix for inventory video campaign config and performance/engagement reporting into AdCenter.

title: YouTube Data / Analytics
cdp_relevance: per-video ad analytics plus VIN-based vehicle video syndication
summary: YouTube Data/Analytics/Reporting APIs that DAS uses via Media Logix for ad analytics and via LotVantage to upload one video per in-stock vehicle to dealer channels.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365
cdp_relevance: dealer account + product/subscription records (Contact/Lead/Opportunity untapped)
summary: Dynamics 365 Web API (OData) that Social Logix/SMRM pulls dealer Account and SalesOrderDetail records from; consumer CRM entities are not yet ingested.

title: Salesforce (SFDC)
cdp_relevance: authoritative dealer account master plus Facebook campaign/lead/review records
summary: Salesforce serving DAS as both dealer-of-record master (Account product flags/config) and a Facebook campaign-data and lead repository for DAS.sln.

title: Tekion DMS
cdp_relevance: closed deals + closed ROs (Review Surge) and CRM lead data (manual CSV today)
summary: Tekion ARC cloud DMS/CRM API: Review Surge consumes closed deals/ROs via API while CDXP ingests CRM leads through a manual 10k-row CSV-to-FTP bottleneck.

title: ETS Facebook Messenger + SMS Proxy
cdp_relevance: inbound consumer Messenger/SMS conversation routing signals
summary: ETS multi-channel gateway routing inbound Facebook Messenger and SMS messages into Rocket.Chat omnichannel via the BCProxy DB and Animator config.

title: Mailgun
cdp_relevance: per-consumer email engagement events (delivered/open/click/bounce) keyed by c_hashkey
summary: Mailgun is the CDXP/3Birds transactional email layer; HMAC-signed webhooks land lifecycle events in marketing.engagement keyed to consumers by c_hashkey.

title: Mandrill
cdp_relevance: lead-alert email engagement (opens/clicks) with lead metadata
summary: Mandrill (Mailchimp Transactional) sends real-time lead-alert emails for Response Path / Response Logix with open/click tracking and lead metadata.

title: Microsoft Graph / Outlook
cdp_relevance: inbound dealer-mailbox email content + customer intent extraction (spike stage)
summary: Researched & verified 2026-06-21 (double pass). Microsoft Graph/Outlook API as Radar's email read/send layer, currently a spike with a foundational RadarMail class implemented.

title: NeverBounce
cdp_relevance: email-address validity/quality signals for suppression
summary: NeverBounce validates email addresses before Mautic import for CDXP, filtering invalid/disposable addresses and feeding suppression lists.

title: SendGrid
cdp_relevance: transactional email/SMS delivery + engagement across multiple DAS products
summary: SendGrid is DAS's primary transactional email/SMS delivery platform serving the Communications API, LiveJoin3, Response Logix, and CDXP.

title: QuickBooks
cdp_relevance: dealer invoice/AR billing records (LotVantage)
summary: QuickBooks API powering LotVantage invoice creation, billing sync, and AR integration for dealer billing.

title: Zuora
cdp_relevance: dealer subscription/MRR billing state (LotVantage)
summary: Zuora API managing LotVantage dealer subscription lifecycle, recurring invoices, and MRR as the billing source of truth.

title: Experian Conquest
cdp_relevance: in-market consumer prospect lists with buyer-intent + demographics
summary: Experian Conquest supplies pre-identified in-market automotive consumer lists for CDXP bulk conquest campaigns, ingested via Mautic ETL with 90-day purge.

title: MaxMind GeoIP2
cdp_relevance: IP-based geolocation (city/region/timezone) + Do-Not-Sell compliance signals
summary: MaxMind GeoIP2 powers IP-based location enrichment of CDXP-Mautic contacts and CCPA Do-Not-Sell compliance workflows.

title: ETS Dashboard
cdp_relevance: dealer account/joiner-rule configuration for ETS chat coordination
summary: ETS Dashboard API is the control plane for Engage To Sell managing dealer account config, joiner rules, and departments, syncing with LiveJoin3 and Rocket.Chat.

title: LiveJoin3 Service
cdp_relevance: real-time joiner-invitation events and chat-engagement signals
summary: LiveJoin3 is the ETS processing/orchestration engine evaluating joiner rules and coordinating SMS/email invites and WebSocket joiner notifications from Rocket.Chat events.

title: Rocket.Chat (ETS Instance)
cdp_relevance: live-chat lead events + omnichannel consumer conversation signals
summary: Rocket.Chat (ETS instance) is the ETS live-chat engine hosting the Lead Plugin that detects qualifying chat events and coordinates LiveJoin3 joiner invitations across web/Facebook/SMS.

title: CallRevu
cdp_relevance: call attribution + VOI signals (disposition, intent score, vehicle of interest)
summary: CallRevu is an automotive call-intelligence platform using Dynamic Number Insertion plus AI call analysis (disposition, intent, vehicle of interest) exposed via a REST API.

title: Craigslist Bulk Posting Interface
cdp_relevance: vehicle listing syndication only (no inbound/consumer data path)
summary: Craigslist's write-only Bulk Posting Interface accepts XML vehicle listings for approved dealers/partners with no read, analytics, or inbound consumer data.

title: eBay
cdp_relevance: vehicle listing syndication + order/lead routing via LotVantage
summary: eBay Trading API powering LotVantage dealer inventory syndication to eBay Motors with fixed-price listings, inventory sync, and lead routing.

title: Facebook Marketplace
cdp_relevance: vehicle catalog publishing + Marketplace lead-form consumer contact/interest
summary: Meta Catalog API publishing dealer vehicle inventory to Facebook Marketplace (and AIA) with Marketplace lead forms capturing consumer contact and vehicle interest.

title: Mozenda
cdp_relevance: scraped reviews from platforms lacking official APIs (review service)
summary: Mozenda is DAS's web-scraping source in the Review Service, scraping reviews from platforms without official APIs (paired with Vendasta's API aggregation).

title: DealerRater
cdp_relevance: per-dealer reviews + multi-dimensional rating aggregates
summary: DealerRater (Cars Commerce Reputation Services) API feeds the DAS Review Service via sl-reviews-dealerater-fa-prod, supplying structured dealer reviews into the Radar reputation dashboard.

title: Soci
cdp_relevance: social content publishing + AI review responses (engagement-ingest unknown)
summary: Soci is Social Logix's social publishing and reputation execution layer (content publishing, Genius Reputation responses, NAP sync), primarily outbound via social-logix-app-api.

title: Vendasta Reputation Intelligence
cdp_relevance: normalized cross-platform review aggregation (100+ directories)
summary: Vendasta's Reputation Intelligence API aggregates reviews/listings/mentions across 100+ directories into the DAS Review Service for Social Logix and Radar (paired with Mozenda).

title: Yext
cdp_relevance: dealer NAP/listing sync across 200+ directories (Social Logix Local)
summary: Yext is the NAP/listing synchronization layer for Social Logix Local, pushing dealer business entity data to 200+ publisher directories (Google, Apple Maps, Yelp, Facebook).

title: BlackBook
cdp_relevance: per-vehicle equity position + market value (CDP fields 23/24)
summary: BlackBook wholesale valuation API used in the CDXP/3Birds equity email pipeline, supplying the only confirmed working enrichment fields (EquityAmount, MarketValue) in the MVP spec.

title: Carfax
cdp_relevance: VIN-level vehicle history + listing badges (1-Owner, FreeCarfax)
summary: Carfax bidirectional file/API integration: DAS sends listing XML for VHR badge attachment and receives VIN-level badge eligibility, used by Radar, LotVantage, and Social Logix.

title: CarGurus
cdp_relevance: dealer reviews/ratings plus ADF lead consumer identity
summary: CarGurus plays two roles in the DAS surface: a review/ratings platform ingested by Social Logix and a lead provider delivering consumer vehicle inquiries via ADF/XML email.

title: Edmunds
cdp_relevance: ADF consumer leads plus dealer review/rating data
summary: Edmunds operates two independent surfaces: ADF email consumer leads routed into ResponseLogix and a dealer Ratings/Reviews REST API feeding the Radar reputation product.

title: Cars.com
cdp_relevance: dealer review aggregates (dealer enrichment) plus ADF lead consumer identity
summary: Cars.com (Cars Commerce) plays a dual role at DAS: a read-only dealer-review source polled by sl-reviews-cardotcom-fa-prod into the Review Service/Radar, and a separate ADF/XML email lead provider under ResponseLogix. Review payloads carry no consumer PII beyond reviewer display name.

title: Kelley Blue Book (KBB)
cdp_relevance: consumer trade-in/retail value + trade-in intent signal (Phase 2; complements BlackBook)
summary: Researched & verified 2026-06-21 (double pass). Kelley Blue Book (Cox Automotive) IDWS 4.0 powers the CDXP/Response Path Trade-In card, returning consumer-facing trade-in and retail values from consumer-submitted VIN/mileage/condition. No ETL-layer integration found — real-time widget calls only; the trade-in submission is itself a high-intent lifecycle signal.

title: Recall Masters
cdp_relevance: sole confirmed candidate source for CDP fields #17 (OpenRecallsByVIN) and #18 (CompletedRecallsByVIN)
summary: Recall Masters is a net-new (no confirmed DAS integration) REST API returning NHTSA-sourced per-VIN recall data enriched with part-availability status and near-real-time freshness. Proposed primary source for CDP recall fields #17/#18, gating recall service campaigns on part availability; VIN-only lookup, no consumer PII.

title: CyberSource
cdp_relevance: payment gateway for LotVantage dealer billing — B2B only, no consumer data for CDP
summary: CyberSource payment gateway used by LotVantage for dealer billing; P4 CDP priority — billing plumbing only, no consumer identity or behavioral data.

title: OpenAI
cdp_relevance: AI capability layer, not a consumer-data source — nothing to ingest. CDP value is reuse of DAS central AI service for LLM-assisted identity/enrichment (Phase 3); PII-to-LLM governance (tokenize at boundary, consent, DPA/ZDR) required.
summary: Researched 2026-06-21 — public API facts web-verified (surface, auth, models, data-retention). DAS-noted models gpt-4o/tts-1 are prior-generation; DAS-internal usage unverified.

title: Gemini
cdp_relevance: AI fallback LLM (Central AI Service resilience), not a consumer-data source. PII-to-LLM governance required; prefer Vertex/paid tier (paid + Vertex are not trained on; free tier is).
summary: Researched 2026-06-21 — public API facts web-verified (surface, auth, models, data policy). Google AI vs Vertex governance distinction noted; DAS-internal usage unverified.

title: Twilio
cdp_relevance: Communications channel + consent/engagement signal source: phone as identity key, message/call status-callback events, and opt-out (STOP/HELP) as a first-class consent-ledger feed.
summary: Researched 2026-06-21 — public API facts web-verified (surface, auth, webhook HMAC, status events, opt-out, A2P 10DLC). CDXP SMS-proxy relationship + DAS-internal usage unverified.
